answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 39959 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Meaning of Names Question: Please let me know whether the following names are allowed as per Islam or not and also the meaning: My elder brother’s daughter name SHAFANA -JUST BORN. My younger brother’s son name MOHAMED AARIZ - JUST BORN. My son name MOHAMED AFZAL - AGE 1 My elder brother son name MOHAMED FAZIL - AGE 2. Waiting for your response. Answer ID: 39959 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1087/1087/M=1433) (1) We could not get the meaning of Shafana. If this word is Shabana (with B) then it means: night time. (2) Ariz (عریض) means cheek, face, the head clerk of army, occurring event, succeeding (Firoz-ul-Lughat). This name is correct. (3) Muhammad Afzal means pious, finest, best (Firozul Lughat). This name is also correct. (3) Fazil means abundant, excess, surplus, accomplished, excellent, learned. (ibid). This name is also correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
